Definition: from G4126; a sail, i.e. navigation:--course, sailing, voyage.
BiblicalUsage: Ploos is a voyage, a sailing. Paul and his company finished their course from Tyre in Acts 21:7, and the sailing was now dangerous in Acts 27:9, when Paul warned that this voyage would be with hurt and much damage in Acts 27:10.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul's warning stands for every voyage I take without listening — the damage was foretold, and still they sailed.
